excerpt.zh: 这个实体无异于一个拥有智慧的生态圈：众多不同的生命形式早已融合成一个行星尺度的格式塔意识。
excerpt.en: This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

texts.zh: 这个实体无异于一个拥有智慧的生态圈：众多不同的生命形式早已融合成一个行星尺度的格式塔意识。
texts.en: This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

sections.zh:
自记忆伊始，[root.GetHomeWorldName]便始终是那颗名为[root.GetHomeWorldName]的星球。每一根茎蔓、卷须与酶体皆构成自我的一部分——生长、衰败与捕食的永恒平衡。漫长岁月里，[root.GetHomeWorldName]仅能朦胧感知银河的脉动，然星辰早已躁动不安。

一场战役在[root.GetHomeWorldName]的天穹之上爆发。巨型舰艇的残骸如雨坠落，这些异星造物旋即被改造利用。而后，超强耀斑降临……
sections.en:
For as long as memory, [root.GetHomeWorldName] has been the planet [root.GetHomeWorldName]. Every stem, tendril, and enzyme here is a part of the self: a balance of growth, decay, and predation. For ages, [root.GetHomeWorldName] could only dimly perceive the galaxy beyond. Yet the stars have long been restless.

A battle took place in the skies above [root.GetHomeWorldName]. Great vessels rained debris upon its surface - alien artifacts that were quickly repurposed. Then came the superflare...

sections.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到的是刺眼、灼热的光芒。冰川化为奔腾的洪流，而恒星辐射将[root.GetHomeWorldName]焚烧殆尽。整片大陆都被冲刷殆尽。
sections.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Glaciers turned into raging torrents, while stellar radiation scorched [root.GetHomeWorldName] to the roots. An entire continent washed away.

sections.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到的是令人目眩的灼热强光。沙丘熔化成玻璃，狂风将我们的岩壁冲刷得寸草不生。整片大陆彻底沦为不毛之地。
sections.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Dunes melted into glass and scouring winds swept our rock faces clean. An entire continent rendered utterly barren.

sections.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到了那刺眼、灼热的光芒。湖泊沸腾，冰盖融化，恒星辐射将[root.GetHomeWorldName]烧灼殆尽，直至根基。整整一个大陆消失了。
sections.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Lakes boiled and ice sheets melted as stellar radiation scorched [root.GetHomeWorldName] to the roots. An entire continent lost.

sections.zh: [root.GetHomeWorldName]感受到的是令人目眩的灼热强光。数十亿共生体被烈焰风暴与辐射焚毁扫荡，整片大陆的生命痕迹被彻底抹除。
sections.en: [root.GetHomeWorldName] felt it as blinding, scorching light. Billions of our symbionts were scorched and swept away by firestorms and radiation. An entire continent swept clean of life.

sections.zh: 痛苦将我们唤醒。我们第一次意识到自身的脆弱。星海危机四伏，却也蕴藏奇迹。运用所学，我们将萌芽繁衍。终将携此身奔赴群星。
sections.en: The pain awakened us. For the first time, we grasped our fragility. The galaxy is perilous, but it also holds wonders. Using what we have learned, we shall germinate and spread. We will take our self to the stars.

texts.zh: 我们的环境改造孢子完成了任务，第一次将我们的一部分殖民到了外星球上。
texts.en: Our terraforming spores have fulfilled their purpose, delivering a part of our self to colonize an alien world for the first time.

texts.zh: 成为[from.GetName]的同时又还是[root.GetHomeWorldName]……这种感觉无比亲切：一种舒适的存在形式，尽管在一度陌生的恒星下呈现出如此多的新形式。我们很容易就适应了这里原有的条件。
texts.en: Becoming [from.GetName] as well as [root.GetHomeWorldName]... It already feels so familiar to us: a comfortable way of being, despite taking on so many new forms under a once-alien sun. We have adapted easily to the pre-existing conditions here.

texts.zh: 适应[from.GetClassAdj][from.GetName]是具有一定挑战的，但我们已经发现了可循之径。卷须延伸处，栖息地即成，饥饿之口也就开始了狩猎。
texts.en: Adapting our self to suit [from.GetClassAdj] [from.GetName] will have its challenges, but we have already found familiar ways to cope. Tendrils extend, habitats are carved out, and hungry mouths hunt.

texts.zh: 作为[root.GetHomeWorldName]这颗行星，我们一直都在干旱的大气层中兴盛发展。所以我们也应该面对成为[from.GetClassAdj][from.GetName]的挑战。我们已经发现了新寻找并储存湿气的方法，学会与这种新的极具挑战的地理环境互相合作，而非互相对抗。
texts.en: As the planet [root.GetHomeWorldName], we have always thrived in parched atmosphere. So too shall we rise to the challenge of becoming [from.GetClassAdj] [from.GetName]. Already we have found new ways to seek and conserve moisture, and learned to work with this challenging new geology, rather than against it.

texts.zh: 正如我们曾在[root.GetHomeWorldName]的水域中繁荣昌盛一样，我们也将作为[from.GetClassAdj][from.GetName]蓬勃发展。这里的矿物、水流，甚至日照量都让人感到陌生，但我们已经找到了提取所需资源的方法。
texts.en: Just as we thrived in and amongst the waters of [root.GetHomeWorldName], so too shall we flourish as [from.GetClassAdj] [from.GetName]. The minerals, the currents, and even the amount of daylight we receive feel strange here, but we have already found ways to extract what we need.

texts.zh: 我们深知成为[from.GetName]将充满挑战。确实，曾经构成[root.capital_scope.GetClassAdj]行星[root.GetHomeWorldName]的我们的一部分已经在这里逐渐消逝，但存活下来的部分依旧十分坚韧，并开始适应当地环境。这种陌生的环境使得获取维持生命的基本资源变得更加困难——然而，在这片寒冷的土地上，我们观察到生命已经找到了生存之道。
texts.en: We knew that becoming [from.GetName] would be challenging. Indeed, some of what made us the [root.capital_scope.GetClassAdj] planet [root.GetHomeWorldName] has already withered away here, but what remains is strong, and has begun to adapt. This unfamiliar environment makes acquiring basic, life-sustaining resources all the more difficult - but clinging to this frigid landscape, we observe that life has already found a way.

texts.zh: 这个地方唤起了我们内心深处的原始恐惧：如此炎热干燥，它唤醒了我们关于焦土的本能记忆。但是，如果我们能够适应并在这里繁荣发展……成为[from.GetName]，或许也会在我们自身之中唤醒某种新的东西。在有水分的地方，我们已经找到了储存水分的方法。在缺少阴凉的地方，我们已经找到了提供阴凉的方法。
texts.en: This place evokes a primal fear for us: so hot and dry that it awakens instinctive memories of The Scorch. If we can adapt and thrive here, though... Becoming [from.GetName] may awaken something new in ourselves, too. Where moisture exists, we have found ways to store it. Where shade was scarce, we have found ways to provide our own.

texts.zh: 我们努力成为[from.GetName]的过程将充满挑战，但我们已经做好了抵御腐朽和洪水的准备。我们中那些更擅长处理水分的部分现在为那些较为脆弱的部分疏导水分。我们已经适应了这个地方的独特水流。
texts.en: Our effort to become [from.GetName] will be challenging, but we have braced our self against rot and deluge. Those parts of us more capable of handling water now wick it away for those which are more vulnerable. We have embraced the unique currents of this place.

texts.zh: 成为[from.GetName]的同时又还是[root.GetHomeWorldName]……这种感觉无比亲切：一种舒适的存在形式，尽管在一度陌生的恒星下呈现出如此多的新形式。我们很容易就适应了这里原有的条件。
texts.en: Becoming [from.GetName] as well as [root.GetHomeWorldName]... It already feels so familiar to us: a comfortable way of being, despite taking on so many new forms under a once-alien sun. We have adapted easily to the pre-existing conditions here.

texts.zh: 我们的上层建筑、营养物质，甚至我们的DNA，已经开始与这里早先存在的生命体适应并融合。[from.GetName]正在苏醒。
texts.en: Our superstructures, our nutrients and our very DNA have begun adapting and mingling with the life that existed here before us. [from.GetName] is waking up.

label.zh: 很快，我们的世界将合而为一。
label.en: Soon our worlds shall become one.

texts.zh:
目睹[from.GetName]的荒凉或许令人痛心，但这种状况不会持续太久。迄今为止，星系中的生命似乎一直忽视这颗贫瘠的星球，但现在，我们，[root.GetName]，掌握着改造这一切的工具和知识。

尽管我们已经学到了很多，但恢复[from.GetName]仍然是一项艰巨的任务。凭借我们的意志，以及我们所发现的能够改变气候的工具，生命很快将会在原本一无所有的地方出现。
texts.en:
The desolation of [from.GetName] is perhaps painful to witness, but not for much longer. Life in this galaxy has so far seen fit to ignore this barren world, but now we, the [root.GetName], wield the tools and knowledge to amend this.

Despite all we have learned so far, we face a daunting task in the restoration of [from.GetName]. By our will, and with the climate-altering tools we have discovered, life shall soon exist where previously there was none.

texts.zh: 虽然[from.GetName]上我们所知的生命可能已经消逝，但我们现在已经准备好给予这个世界第二次机会。我们已经开始修复它的大气层、水道和土壤，以便[from.GetName]可以再次以[root.GetName]的形式孕育生命。
texts.en: Though life as we know it on [from.GetName] may have been snuffed out, we are now primed to give the world a second chance. We have begun the work of restoring its atmosphere, watercourses, and soil so that [from.GetName] may once again host life in the form of the [root.GetName].

texts.zh:
进化的熔炉在我们[root.GetName]身上创造了奇迹。如今，我们有机会为[from.GetPlanetMoon][from.GetName]带来更多。我们掌握着先前的自我难以想象的工具和知识，已经开始将[from.GetName]塑造成一个觉醒的过程注定与众不同的地方。

[from.GetName]的根基终有一日会充满养分，被我们动植物充满活力的生命周期所滋养。山谷、山脊和高原将提供充足的空间用于觅食、狩猎和庇护。生命将在这里繁荣昌盛。
texts.en:
The crucible of evolution has made wonders of us, the [root.GetName]. Now though, we have the opportunity to impart so much more for the [from.GetPlanetMoon] [from.GetName]. Wielding tools and knowledge our earlier self could scarcely conceive of, we have begun shaping [from.GetName] into a place whose awakening is sure to be unlike any other.

The foundations of [from.GetName] shall one day teem with nutrients, refreshed by the vibrant life cycles of our flora and fauna. Valleys, ridges and plateaux will offer bountiful space for foraging, hunting and shelter. Life shall flourish here.

texts.zh: 我们半自主的[owner.GetOperativesLowerPlural]已经确定了几个适合我们独特微生物群落的生存地点。现在他们将对这些栖息地进行一段时间的监测，优先考虑那些能为我们提供最大长期成功机会的地点。
texts.en: Our semi-autonomous [owner.GetOperativesLowerPlural] have identified several viable sites for our unique microbiome. They will now monitor these habitats for a time, prioritizing those which offer us the greatest chance of long-term success.

texts.zh:
我们已获得一位不知情的[target.GetSpeciesAdj]协助，对方误以为即将参与的是一项尽责的自然保护行动。殊不知，他们正要将我们的"种子炸弹"微生物群投送至[roots_planet.GetPlanetMoon] [roots_planet.GetName]的偏远地带。

尽管这个培养舱培育的共生体可能寿命短暂，永远无法成为我们意识的完整延伸，但我们能感受到它们渴望尽其所能渗透并观测这片异星地貌的迫切。
texts.en:
We have secured the aid of an unwitting [target.GetSpeciesAdj] who believes they are about to engage in a dutiful act of nature conservation. Instead they are poised to deliver our 'seed bomb' microbiome to a hinterland site on [roots_planet.GetPlanetMoon] [roots_planet.GetName].

Although the symbionts bred within this package may be short-lived, and shall never amount to a full extension of our self, we feel their eagerness to infiltrate and observe this alien landscape as much as they are able.

texts.zh:
从我们的微生物群被送达至新的[GetRootsBlockerName]处所的那一刻起，我们就开始吸入其禁忌的空气，并感知名为[roots_planet.GetName]的世界。

只要这些共生体与我们更广泛的自我保持根本上的脱节，我们在此的存在将是脆弱的。然而，当时机到来，我们将在[target.GetAdj]空间恢复行动时，它们将很好地为我们服务。
texts.en:
From the moment our microbiome was delivered to its new [GetRootsBlockerName] home we began to take in its forbidden air, and to perceive the world known as [roots_planet.GetName].

Our presence here shall be tenuous, so long as these symbionts remain fundamentally disconnected from our wider self. However, they will serve us well when the time comes to resume operations in [target.GetAdj] space.

label.zh: 我们的根基应当扎得更深，存续更久。
label.en: Our roots should delve deeper, last longer.

label.zh: 让我们的根须在此肆意生长。
label.en: Let our roots run rampant here.
